friendly_name: One owner for build state, a smaller config.ts, and an honest agent API
purpose_context: Two integrations still pass draft-publication state through a mutated options object and a globalThis sink, config.ts has grown to 2,298 lines, and adopter docs point at a sitemap path and agent-API links that the site does not serve. This mission fixes the docs and adds the agent-API links (#103), gives the build state one owner and splits config.ts (#115), and settles how DocKitty treats redirects to drafts and its env-file reader.
purpose_tldr: Give DocKitty's draft-publication build state one owner, split the oversized config module along its existing seams, and make the agent-API index and docs match what the site really serves.
